newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson up after Motorola Q4 report.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson up after Motorola Q4 report.

text.p: Shares in Swedish telecommunications group Ericsson opened higher on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Friday, lifted by U.S. rival Motorola 's day-earlier earnings report.
At 0910 GMT, the share was up two crowns at 228 crowns, while the exchange's general index was 0.01 percent higher at 2,435.70.
"In the areas where Ericsson and (Finnish rival) Nokia are active, Motorola's report was ok," a trader said.
Nokia's shares were 6.5 markka higher at 299 markka on the Helsinki Stock Exchange at 0930 GMT.
"For Ericsson and Nokia the report is somewhat better than expected, if you exclude extraordinary items," a London analyst said.
Angela Dean, analyst at Morgan Stanley, said the figures which affected Ericsson were not very surprising.
"It is more the tone of the report," she said. "Motorola breathes optimism within several areas."

Dean mentioned CDMA, a mobile phone system where Ericsson does not compete with the same products, and mobile phone system GSM, where Ericsson is very active. She added Motorola's new mobile phones to the list.
"You could worry that this indicates that Motorola will become a tougher competitor than last year, but the market usually prefers to look at the positive side of competitors' reports," Dean said.
